messages.subject: Re: [RJ library] Examples?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Stephan,
Thanks for hints. In my case, I will run R from the process launched from
my plugin. So at the end I will run R from standalone Java application.
For test purpose, I created an example:
https://github.com/marekjagielski/R-from-Java . I have to still understand
the API. It seems to be not difficult to use.

Btw. It would be useful to add libraries:
https://github.com/marekjagielski/R-from-Java/tree/master/lib to maven
central repo.

Thanks,

Marek

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

My way of using RServi is as in
https://github.com/marekjagielski/R-from-Java.  I would like to ask if
there is a way to redirect streams to standard Java that I could see
e.g. cat("Hello from R") in Java output console?

Thanks,

Marek Jagielski

messages.subject: Re: [RServi] Way to redirect streams to System.out and System.in
messages.subject_clean: [RServi] Way to redirect streams to System.out and System.in
messages.body_plain:
Hi Marek,

the output is printed to stdout if you start the RServi node in debug 
mode. The debug mode is enabled by setting the Java property 
'de.walware.rj.debug'.

Regards,
Stephan

messages.body_plain:
Hi Marek,

maybe the current RServi doesn't offer at Java level what you are 
looking for.  You can also use R function capture.output to collect the 
output of your functions.

If you want a full console, simply use StatET.

Regards,
Stephan
